GOLD, MINING & OPPORTUNITIES

Central African Republic

Gold and diamonds underpin the mining sector, with opportunities for better exploration data and responsible site development.

COUNTRY OVERVIEW

Mining at a glance.

Key minerals
Gold · Diamonds
Geographic focus
Western and central mineral districts
01 / GOLD

Gold in Central African Republic.

Gold is one of the Central African Republic’s principal mined commodities. Small-scale mining plays a major role. Assessing a gold prospect requires site-specific sampling to understand the deposit and the reliability of existing information.

02 / MINING

The wider mining sector.

Gold and diamond mining are important to the country’s exports. Diamond workings are widely distributed, with documented alluvial fields in the west and east. Access, local working arrangements and the origin of material need close attention.

03 / OPPORTUNITIES

Where to explore potential.

Areas for technical assessment, subject to site verification and feasibility.

01

Build reliable gold data

Review historical information and plan geological mapping and sampling to evaluate prospective ground.

02

Support safer mining

Assess excavation practices, water management and rehabilitation needs at authorised small-scale sites.

03

Assess diamond ground

Review alluvial deposit information alongside access, traceability and certification requirements before considering a project.

Before moving forward

Assess local security, site safety, mineral rights and community land use before work begins. Diamond opportunities also require verification of the applicable certification and export requirements.
